meta.sourceNote: All vocabulary items and all categories come from the OCR GCSE German Vocabulary List. Articles, example sentences and example translations were added as metadata for the existing entries; no words were added.
meta.cefrNote: Approximate mapping of the document's Foundation/Higher tier. The OCR list does not state CEFR levels itself.

frequency.note: Word forms ranked by frequency in film and television subtitles. This is a list of surface forms, not lemmas, and it skews spoken and colloquial German. It is not a CEFR list and implies nothing about level.

sources: Der deutsche Wortschatz von A1 bis B2
cefr.note: A word is listed at the lowest level any source assigns it. Levels A1-B1 come from the official Goethe-Institut word lists, each transcribed entry verified against the published PDF. B2 rests on the Lingster Academy list alone, which is the only source here that reaches B2.
